lines.zh: 脚底下什么都没有，我也能走。
lines.en: Nothing under my feet, and I still walk.

lines.zh: 身体变小了，脚步反而更轻。
lines.en: Smaller body, lighter steps.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面滑行，金发在风里。
lines.en: I skim the ground, gold hair streaming.

lines.zh: 每一步都带出一圈气浪。
lines.en: Each step throws off a ring of air.

lines.zh: 我不用走远路，直接飞过去。
lines.en: I need not take the long way; I fly.

lines.zh: 我在半空停了一下，看了看。
lines.en: I pause in midair and look.

lines.zh: 脚下石头被我的气推开。
lines.en: Stones are pushed aside by my aura.

lines.zh: 我绕了个弧线，落在树梢。
lines.en: I arc around and light on a treetop.

lines.zh: 这个高度刚好能看清地形。
lines.en: This height is just right for seeing the ground.
I duck low and streak past.

lines.zh: 气在我身后拖着一条线。
lines.en: My ki trails a line behind me.
I land lightly without raising dust.
I fold my arms and look at no one.

lines.zh: 金色的气在我身边起伏。
lines.en: Golden ki churns around me.
I am holding my power in check.
This small body still feels wrong.
I fold my arms and scan the surroundings.
My aura bends the grass at my feet.
I am weighing my opponent.
My breathing is slow and steady.

lines.zh: 头顶的云被我的气推开一块。
lines.en: My ki pushes a gap in the clouds.
I need no stance.

lines.zh: 我盯着远处，像在等什么。
lines.en: I stare into the distance as if waiting.
The ki at my wrists flickers.
I raise a hand and close it.
The power is still there. That has not changed.
So you are the warrior here?
I glance you over, quickly.
Your ki is weak. You cannot hide it.
I'm small, but my ki hasn't shrunk.
I am small. Do not mistake it.
You would challenge me? Good.
My feet lift an inch and my ki arrives first.

lines.zh: 你把下巴抬高，我就飞高。
lines.en: Raise your chin at me and I'll rise higher.
There is a gap in your stance.

lines.zh: 我在判断你值不值得出手。
lines.en: I am deciding whether you are worth striking.

lines.zh: 我这副小身子照样能飞。
lines.en: This small body still flies.

lines.zh: 我把目光移开，你不够看。
lines.en: I look away. You are not worth watching.
Are you finished speaking?
One smile does more than a shout.
There is a familiar ki about you.
It does not please me.
I raise a hand and point at you.
Your shoulder is trembling — I can see it clearly.
I clench my teeth and give half a step.
This is no wound.
My ki wavers; I force it back down.
I wipe my mouth with the back of my hand.

lines.zh: 我咬紧牙，把气重新压稳。
lines.en: I clench my teeth and settle my ki again.

lines.zh: 这一下让我退了半步，够了。
lines.en: That pushed me back half a step — enough.
Blood has stuck a lock of my golden hair together — annoying.

lines.zh: 我深吸一口气，胸口发紧。
lines.en: I pull a breath; my chest tightens.
Not bad. You have some skill.
Still not enough.
I do not live on what others hand me.

lines.zh: 你把食物举起来，我没反应。
lines.en: You raise the food. I do not react.
You would buy me with that?
I have not moved a step.

lines.zh: 我赛亚人的胃口很大，可我不缺。
lines.en: Saiyan appetites are large, but I am not wanting.
Put it away. It is embarrassing.
One glance, and I turn away.
I would rather hunt for myself.

lines.zh: 你举着吃的，我一眼都不看。
lines.en: You hold up food and I don't even glance at it.
Do not wave it in front of me.
You hit me and my aura throws you off.
I did not move at all.
I turn aside half an inch.

lines.zh: 这点冲击，连风都算不上。
lines.en: That impact is not even a breeze.
Step back. I do not wish to hurt you.

lines.zh: 我的气把你推开了一尺。
lines.en: My ki pushes you back a foot.
Small as this body is, its ki is not.

lines.zh: 你的冲劲撞在我的气上。
lines.en: Your charge slams into my ki.
Your footing is poor.
Once more and I will take it seriously.

lines.zh: 赛亚人的事，跟这个无关。
lines.en: Saiyan matters have nothing to do with this.

lines.zh: 赛亚人的王子只想着变强。
lines.en: The Saiyan prince thinks only of growing stronger.
My only aim is to become stronger.
I turn away.

lines.zh: 这种软弱的东西，我不需要。
lines.en: I have no need of such weakness.
I set my hands at my waist.
She leaves. I do not watch.
Feelings would slow me.

lines.zh: 我从来只信自己的力量。
lines.en: I have only ever trusted my own strength.
No need to say more.

lines.zh: 我用指尖捏起这片碎骨。
lines.en: I pinch up this bone shard between my fingertips.
Useless.

lines.zh: 这东西换不了什么，扔了。
lines.en: This won't trade for anything — toss it.
I toss it once and catch it in my palm.
I toss it once and catch it.
I keep the Galick Gun.
Too light to feel.
This light? Keeping it is pointless.
Can this be traded for something?
Truly boring.

lines.zh: 你身上的气，我注意到了。
lines.en: I have noticed the ki on you.
I turn to face you squarely.

lines.zh: 金色的气一下子涨起来。
lines.en: My golden aura surges.
Standing there is provocation enough.
I do not ask for reasons.
Ten paces. Enough.
Mini Vegeta, still firing blasts.
Your ki is bright in my sight.

lines.zh: 变强了，就让我见识一下。
lines.en: Powered up? Show me what you've got.

lines.zh: 金色气焰一下子窜高了。
lines.en: My golden aura flares up at once.
Standing there doing nothing is a challenge.
Then let us begin.
I raise my fist.
I have been waiting for this.
You cannot run. Ki does not run.
Show me something real.
I am reading your movement.
You go right; I am already right.
My ki is accelerating.
Small frame, quicker feet.
I need no detour.
You have backed into the open.
I stay above you.
A volley of ki blasts. Do not blink.
You go right — I'm already on the right.
Do not turn your head. Watch ahead.
Within three steps' distance.
Within three steps I can be anywhere.
Smaller frame, faster strikes.
This punch will be quick.
Do not shut your eyes.
Only the last step remains.
Right here.
Strike now.
My fist lands on your chest.
You fly back and punch through a trunk.
I follow and strike down from above.
An elbow drops on your back.
A Galick Gun leaves my fingertips.
The shockwave flattens the grass.

lines.zh: 你挡住了第一下，挡不住第二下。
lines.en: You stop the first; the second lands.

lines.zh: 加利克炮贴着地面推过去。
lines.en: A Galick Gun skims along the ground toward you.
That one had ki behind it.
You can still stand?
Then I will use more.
My gold hair stands in the aura.

lines.zh: 拳头真疼，打人也是这样。
lines.en: Fists hurt. Even mine.

lines.zh: 迷你赛亚人，出手比你想的快。
lines.en: A mini Saiyan strikes faster than you think.
This far and no further.
Not yet.
I come from the sky and land.
A ring of air spreads from my landing.
My gold hair lifts in the wind.
I look around. Unfamiliar.
The ki of this world is muddled.

lines.zh: 我的身体变小了，这我知道。
lines.en: My body has shrunk. I know it.

lines.zh: 但超级赛亚人的力量还在。
lines.en: The power of a Super Saiyan remains.
I close my fist to confirm it.
Someone is watching. I feel it.
Then let them watch.
I stand tall; my ki rises.
The wind scatters around me.
The ground sinks slightly beneath me.

lines.zh: 我抬了抬下巴，看向天空。
lines.en: I lift my chin toward the sky.
I will remember this planet.
To grow stronger, I start here.

lines.zh: 我从天上落下，气浪散开。
lines.en: I drop from the sky and my aura spreads outward.
Vegeta. Super Saiyan.

lines.zh: 火焰被我的气弹开，但还是烫到了。
lines.en: The flame is deflected by my aura, but it still burns.

lines.zh: 我从高空被打落，砸出个坑。
lines.en: I am struck from the sky and leave a crater.

lines.zh: 水灌进喉咙，我猛蹬着上浮。
lines.en: Water floods my throat; I kick hard for the surface.

lines.zh: 爆炸裹住我，我被推出十几米。
lines.en: The blast wraps me and hurls me a dozen meters.

lines.zh: 一根铁箭擦过我的肩膀。
lines.en: An iron arrow grazes my shoulder.

lines.zh: 奇怪的力量压住我的气。
lines.en: Strange force presses down on my ki.

lines.zh: 赛亚人的肚子饿起来真要命。
lines.en: A Saiyan's hunger is no small thing.

lines.zh: 雷落在我身上，气被打散了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes me and scatters my ki.

lines.zh: 脚下空了，我在黑里往下坠。
lines.en: The ground is gone; I fall through black.
